svg.title: Action Button spacing
svg.desc: Deploy and its supplied rocket icon morph into Deploying and the spinner. A medium primary Action Button with labels.pending set to Deploying, drawn at three times actual size; without that label override, the resting label remains while pending. This example chooses a 128-pixel button width. The fixed height is 34 pixels, with 14-pixel horizontal padding, a 16-pixel status icon, a 10-pixel icon-to-label gap, and a 20-pixel text line box. The label track reserves the widest state so the button keeps its width.
